data.one_liner: Sign in with Google for the Serverpod auth module
data.what_it_does: Provides Google sign-in integration specifically designed for the Serverpod authentication module in Flutter applications. It enables users to authenticate with their Google accounts and connects with a Serverpod backend.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Serverpod as the backend
You want to allow users to sign in using their Google accounts
avoid_when: You are not using Serverpod as your backend architecture
You only need standard Firebase Authentication without Serverpod
strengths: Seamless integration with Serverpod auth module
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Serverpod ecosystem
Minimal documentation available in the package README
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Google Sign-In credentials for each targeted platform and setting up the Serverpod backend authentication module.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using a standard backend or Firebase instead of Serverpod and need direct Google authentication control.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your entire backend infrastructure is built around Firebase services.
